scanNotes: 2026-10-26: Searched the next 60 days through 25 December and Indian performances/celebrations through February 2027. Public search, organiser, venue, city and booking pages supplied partial coverage.

Added SeeLightNight (12 November), Gioiello Ensemble (8 November), Alma Rosé memorial concert (3 November, free ticket required; live availability unverified), and the explicitly published Vintage Vintage date (7 November, preserving its established ID).

Added seven explicitly published occurrences to existing Charlie P’s records: Bits & Bites on 2 and 9 November; Medical Tuesday on 3 and 10 November; Just for Kicks on 4 November; karaoke on 5 November; Happy Friday on 6 November. No dates inferred from recurrence. The Halloween page now names DJ Soluka.

Removed the completed DJ Soluka occurrence, which ended early on 26 October, and the completed 25 October Am Himmel occurrence. Rechecked Am Himmel, Glow, Karawoke, UTSAV, Prater Halloween, the 28 October American Improv page and the six retained Charlie P’s records.

The Comedy Pub’s three individual pages could not be accessed. Their existing checked dates are unchanged. Other retained sources not rechecked also retain their dates. American Improv still displays a waiting-list notice and external Meetup booking; Meetup availability was not verified.

Alma Rosé Eventjet page loaded without usable live inventory; the venue explicitly confirms free entry with admission tickets. Ein Song für Wien is talks/workshops rather than a concert and was excluded. TU Wien Diwali programme remains under construction and admission terms are unverified, so it was not added.

Cinema/theatre, Indian touring and nearby/fireworks searches yielded no additional fully verified matches. Viennale’s event directory did not expose useful admission information; no listings were inferred. No claim of complete coverage.
